implementation_notes: This is an enforcement decree (시행령) draft for the AI Basic Act (법률 제20676호, enacted 2025-01-21, effective 2026-01-22). Key provisions: (1) AI systems with cumulative training compute ≥10^26 FLOPs are subject to safety assurance obligations; (2) Transparency obligations apply to AI business operators but are exempted for internal business use; (3) High-impact AI operators must document risk management measures and publish key contents publicly; (4) High-impact AI impact assessments must include use behavior analysis and fundamental rights identification; (5) National security and defense AI applications are explicitly excluded from the Act's scope. Legislative notice period: 2025-11-12 to 2025-12-22.
